clearVariation.sourceText: The acetate Clear Variation (/10) also returns, averaging 1:826 Hobby packs.
clearVariation.reason: REVIEW FIX: Clear Variation is grouped in the source's prose with Golden Mirror Variation / Team Color Border Variations / True Photo Variations -- a base PHOTO VARIATION (distinct card identity per doctrine, project_image_variations_are_named_cards), not a colour rung of the numbered base card, and it is short-printed (1:826 Hobby, not a per-card guarantee). Confirmed absent from the actual '2025 Topps Series 2 Baseball Base Parallels List' <ul> itself (checked by extracting that exact <ul> element, not just nearby prose) -- unlike 2025 Topps UPDATE Series, where Clear Variation IS inside that product's own Base Parallels List <ul> and is correctly minted there. Held out of this ladder rather than stamped across all 350 base cards.

spellingAudit: Cross-checked every rung name in this ladder against backend/data/checklist-parallel-names.json's topps-family entries (normalized, word-order/plural/punctuation-insensitive) and against every other staged Topps CSV in the repo (acq-2026-09-15-ladders, today's acq-2026-09-20-beckett-topps-* packages). One real collision found and fixed: `Topps Foil Pattern` (this source's spelling) vs `Topps Pattern Foil` (the live catalog's own spelling for baseball/2025/topps, per reviewer) -- these are DIFFERENT slugs (topps-foil-pattern vs topps-pattern-foil), so using the source's word order would have minted a duplicate rung. Aligned to the catalog's spelling; source spelling preserved in `sourceSpelling`. Apostrophe-only differences elsewhere (e.g. straight vs curly quote in Mother's/Father's Day) were checked and confirmed to slug identically via computeHobbyIqCardId -- no action needed. `Gold Holo Foil` / `Holo Gold Foil` and `FoilFractor` / `Foilfractor` matches found in the census belong to unrelated products (2024 Topps Tier One, 2023 Topps Big League) in different cells -- not a collision risk for this cell.
selectCardsOnlyAudit: Verified against the source page's own prose: no 'select cards only' / roster-restriction language appears anywhere in the 2025 Topps Series 2 Baseball Base Parallels List. All 39 minted rungs apply to the full 350-card base run (distribution-only notes -- Hobby/Retail/Hanger/Jumbo exclusive -- are NOT roster restrictions per R40 and are recorded as notes, not omitted). Clear Variation is the one exception discussed above, correctly held out.
cardNumberGapFound: Card #594 (Team Card - Athletics) is a genuine base card omitted by the workbook parser's person-name heuristic (team-only rows have no player name and fail the shape test); added back manually after confirming its presence in the source page's own card-by-card list (verbatim: '594 Team Card - Athletics'). Final base roster is the full 350 cards, #351-700 with no gaps.
